en: I was supposed to meet my friend at six. I was supposed to leave work early, but a meeting ran late. I was supposed to take the subway, but there was a delay. I was supposed to arrive first, but my friend got there before me. I called her and said I would be about ten minutes late. Luckily, she didn't mind waiting a little longer.
ko: 저는 6시에 친구를 만나기로 되어 있었습니다. 일찍 퇴근할 예정이었지만 회의가 늦게 끝났습니다. 지하철을 탈 예정이었지만 운행이 지연되었습니다. 제가 먼저 도착할 예정이었지만 친구가 저보다 먼저 도착했습니다. 저는 친구에게 전화해서 10분 정도 늦을 것 같다고 말했습니다. 다행히 친구는 조금 더 기다리는 것을 괜찮아했습니다.

expressions.example: We're supposed to finish the project by Friday.
The appointment ran late, so I missed my bus.
What time did you get there yesterday?
I don't mind walking if the weather is nice.
